notes_for_editor: The 1964 cab (firelookout.com) and 1965 lookout house (Oregon page) conflict and are reported as such; the 1970 'Emergency' entry is unexplained in the source and is not interpreted. Removal is 1976 per the Oregon page only; firelookout.com marks it gone on the same line as the 1970 entry, with no removal date. The brief's 'ground' kind comes from the Forest Fire Lookout Association index; neither lookout page describes the structure's height or whether it stood on a tower, so the story does not say. Elevation is not in the cached text. No source describes the site today, and access is unknown, so no access or visit facts are recorded. No photos were found.
